title: The Big Bang Theory
description: English dubbing scenes from The Big Bang Theory.
author: Parrotbook

scenes.title: 一份礼物，还是现在？
quotes: A gift! A present! Present!
礼物！一份礼物！礼物！
Yeah!
对了！
Oh, Leonard. Now, how can you not get that?
哦，莱纳德，你怎么会猜不出来呢？
In what universe is that a present?
在哪个宇宙里，这幅画能叫礼物？
It's not a present. It's the present. Look, there's you and me. There's Penny and Amy. We're playing Pictionary in the present.
不是“一份礼物”，是“现在”。看，这是你和我，这是佩妮和艾米。我们现在正在玩你画我猜。
Oh my God, we're gonna kill them.
天哪，咱们肯定能完胜他们。

scenes.title: 上课得准备笔记本
quotes: All right, let us begin. Where's your notebook?
好，开始吧。你的笔记本呢？
Um, I don't have one.
呃，我没带。
How are you going to take notes without a notebook?
没笔记本你怎么记笔记？
I have to take notes?
我还得记笔记？
How else are you gonna study for the tests?
不然你拿什么复习考试呢？
There's gonna be a test?
还要考试？
Tests. Here. That's college-ruled. I hope that's not too intimidating.
是好几场考试。给你，这是大学生用的横线本，希望不会吓到你。
Thank you.
谢谢。
You're welcome.
不客气。

scenes.title: 我可憋不了两千六百年
scenes.english: Not for two thousand six hundred years
quotes: Oh. Two thousand six hundred years?
哦，两千六百年？
Yeah, give or take. As I was saying, it's a warm summer evening in ancient Greece.
对，大概吧。刚才我讲到，古希腊一个温暖的夏夜。
Yes, Penny?
什么事，佩妮？
I have to go to the bathroom.
我想去洗手间。
Well, can't you hold it?
呃，你不能忍一忍吗？
Not for two thousand six hundred years.
我可憋不了两千六百年。
